title: Substar executable system map
authority: This file is the canonical architecture inventory. Generated Markdown and Mermaid files must not be edited by hand.

coverage.rule: Every matched production file must be owned by at least one module code entry or explicitly ignored here.

rules: Read this map before changing a business contract, task state, worker protocol, provider connector or persistent artifact.
List every affected module and contract before editing code.
Do not change only a producer or only a consumer.
Finalizers validate identity, integrity and structure; they never invent or rewrite semantic content.
Retry preserves independently accepted work and reruns only unresolved or uncommitted work.
Update this map and its registered tests in the same change as the code.

project_creation_request.title: Project creation multipart request
project_creation_request.description: Media, optional reference document, explicit normal/reference-script segmentation mode, frozen break symbols and creation settings, including one validated 75--100 second execution-block target.

project_creation_projection.title: Project creation read model
project_creation_projection.description: Stable project status projected from canonical transcription and segmentation tasks.

task_record.title: Durable canonical task
task_record.description: Task identity, attempt, lifecycle, progress, result and structured error.

task_event.title: Durable task event
task_event.description: Append-only state, progress, artifact and terminal event.

worker_command.title: Worker command
worker_command.description: Strict task input, paths, credential references and trace context sent over stdin.

worker_message.title: Worker message
worker_message.description: Strict JSONL ready, progress, artifact, result, error or cancelled event.

worker_completion.title: Worker completion
worker_completion.description: Supervisor-owned process outcome delivered to Scheduler.

credential_reference.title: Purpose/provider credential reference
credential_reference.description: Names such as ASR_qwen and Segment_deepseek; secrets live in a data-root portable encrypted envelope and never enter public task payloads.

transcription_request.title: Transcription request
transcription_request.description: Immutable media identity, language, prompt/hotword snapshots and provider settings.

transcription_result.title: Transcription result
transcription_result.description: Registered immutable evidence artifacts and summary.

provider_submission_audit.title: Provider submission audit
provider_submission_audit.description: Redacted Qwen request identity and resume metadata.

recognition_evidence.title: Immutable recognition evidence
recognition_evidence.description: Original sentence and word hypotheses, timing, language and speaker evidence.

segmentation_request.title: Segmentation request
segmentation_request.description: Immutable binding to transcription evidence, prompts, glossary, limits and an optional reference-primary, ASR-timed symbol-boundary policy.

segmentation_material.title: Canonical segmentation material
segmentation_material.description: Contiguous timed ASR projection: CJK provider blocks expand into equal-duration characters while alphabetic words remain word tokens; reference-script mode preserves ASR wording and timing while adding auditable local corrections, suggestions and reference-owned boundaries.

semantic_grouping_result.title: Model-authored semantic grouping
semantic_grouping_result.description: Meaning groups and model-selected Cue boundaries bound to an input fingerprint.

segmentation_candidate.title: Segmentation candidate
segmentation_candidate.description: Execution plan, accepted groups, Cues, notices and validation summary.

segmentation_result.title: Segmentation worker result
segmentation_result.description: Registered candidate artifacts and immutable document summary.

editor_document.title: Editor document
editor_document.description: Validated source tokens, display tokens, Cues, translations, lineage and reversible reference-manuscript difference metadata.

editor_revision.title: Immutable editor revision
editor_revision.description: Optimistically committed document snapshot or delta with provenance and hash.

editor_operation.title: User editor operation
editor_operation.description: Revision-bound user document edit; never an AI task lock.

translation_request.title: Revision-bound translation request
translation_request.description: User-confirmed source language, target language and revision basis for one translation task.

translation_result.title: AI translation result
translation_result.description: Model-authored meaning-unit plan plus a translated or blank, editable manual-required target for every Cue.

calibration_result.title: AI calibration result
calibration_result.description: Model-authored punctuation, casing, terminology and ASR correction actions under the unified Task Runtime.

media_stream.title: Project media and waveform response
media_stream.description: Range-capable media bytes and bounded waveform windows.

media_info.title: Project media kind descriptor
media_info.description: Project-contained audio/video routing metadata derived from the frozen source manifest and media streams.

settings_snapshot.title: Application and project settings snapshot
settings_snapshot.description: Validated non-secret configuration plus purpose-specific credential presence and restart-bound Worker/cloud/media/GPU/download resource limits.

provider_test_request.title: Provider connectivity and capability probe
provider_test_request.description: Explicit provider, base URL, model, auth mode and temporary credential used only for a test call.

model_stage_policy.title: Per-stage model scheduling policy
model_stage_policy.description: Model, thinking mode, effort, token and temperature settings for primary and repair stages.

production_prompt_component.title: Registered production prompt component
production_prompt_component.description: Editable Markdown content with a SHA-256 concurrency basis; task/language routes and ordered component composition remain registry-owned and immutable through settings.

glossary_snapshot.title: Glossary and provider hotword snapshot
glossary_snapshot.description: Auditable active terminology compiled separately for prompts and ASR hotwords.

reference_document.title: Reference manuscript snapshot
reference_document.description: Fingerprint-bound TXT, DOCX or SRT source and deterministic alignment audit.

subtitle_export.title: Subtitle export
subtitle_export.description: Source, target or bilingual SRT rendered from the current verified revision.

external_ai_exchange.title: External AI prooftranslation and segmentation package
external_ai_exchange.description: Revision-bound structured prooftranslation and token-boundary segmentation packages with strict hashes, preview validation and atomic revision commits.

subtitle_project_exchange.title: Portable subtitle project
subtitle_project_exchange.description: Hash-manifested latest editor document, audit artifacts and original media for atomic cross-Substar import.

project_task_info.title: Canonical project task information
project_task_info.description: The sole project-level authority for display name, source language, target language, source line length, target line length and the optional project-scoped LLM provider selection.

runtime_identity.title: Backend runtime identity
runtime_identity.description: Instance id, PID/start time, install root, data root, build, port and user-visible launch surface used for strict ownership.

release_manifest.title: Portable release manifest
release_manifest.description: Edition, version, packaged capabilities and release identity.

split_ui.title: Project creation UI
split_ui.role: Collect media, source-language-aware normal/reference-script segmentation settings and frozen break symbols, create projects, and project durable task progress.
must_not: Infer task completion from upload completion
Keep cached running state visible after backend polling fails
invariants: Editor link is exposed only when the project read model says awaiting_edit
One submitted identity survives polling and refresh
A polling failure immediately marks the runtime disconnected and never presents cached queued/running rows as live work
Reference upload and break-symbol controls are exposed and submitted only in reference-script mode
Reference-script mode requires a reference document and at least one literal break symbol
Untouched reference break symbols follow the selected source-language preset while explicit user symbols remain authoritative
Completed projects are projected with the configured secondary-color corner

recovery.strategy: Reload the durable project-creation projection.
recovery.terminal: Display structured backend error without changing it.

composition_root.title: FastAPI composition root and project-creation facade
composition_root.role: Own process startup, router composition, uploads, stable project identity, prompt-component HTTP boundaries and the project-creation facade.
must_not: Run provider calls on request threads
Treat a transcription task as an editable project
Store plaintext credentials in task input
invariants: project_id and task_id are distinct
A project becomes awaiting_edit only after an editor revision is readable
A completed packaged beginner tutorial is registered against its canonical editable revision and is repaired during startup reconciliation
Scheduler resource limits are loaded once from the validated settings snapshot at process startup
The same code path serves development and portable builds

recovery.strategy: Reconcile project creation from durable canonical tasks and ProjectStore.

creation_graph.title: Subtitle creation task graph
creation_graph.role: Freeze prompt/reference snapshots and create transcription then segmentation tasks with an explicit dependency.
invariants: Segmentation depends on the exact transcription task
Snapshots are immutable and fingerprinted

recovery.strategy: Recreate the same graph with the same idempotency fingerprints.

creation_projection.title: Project creation read-model projection
creation_projection.role: Combine transcription, segmentation and ProjectStore facts into one UI-safe creation status.
must_not: Assume Worker success means editor readiness
invariants: awaiting_edit requires a readable revision
Structured errors are flattened only for the legacy-shaped UI field
Semantic grouping is projected from 50 to 95 percent using canonical Worker block completion, with validation and publication retaining the final range

recovery.strategy: Recompute from durable sources on every read.

runtime_api.title: Canonical task HTTP API
runtime_api.role: Validate canonical task requests and expose create, list, cancel, retry, events and artifacts.
invariants: All errors use the canonical API error shape
Registered handlers validate before idempotency comparison

recovery.strategy: Clients retry idempotently using the durable task identity.
recovery.terminal: Return structured conflict or validation error.

task_service.title: Task application service
task_service.role: Provide validated task lifecycle operations and redact secrets before persistence or publication.
invariants: All mutations pass the state machine
One instance owns one running attempt
Public payloads contain no secrets

recovery.strategy: Retry creates a new attempt while preserving prior attempt history.

runtime_store.title: SQLite runtime store
runtime_store.role: Persist tasks, attempts, leases, dependencies, events and artifact registrations transactionally.
must_not: Delete accepted attempt history on retry
invariants: State transitions are atomic
Progress is monotonic within an attempt
Artifacts are bound to task_id and attempt

recovery.strategy: Startup reconciliation interrupts abandoned owners without erasing task history.

handler_registry.title: Task handler registry
handler_registry.role: Bind each canonical task type to validate_input, prepare, event handling, finalize and resource requirements.
must_not: Register two handlers for one task type
invariants: Exactly one production handler per task type
Every handler has an explicit finalizer

recovery.strategy: No runtime recovery; application startup must register the complete handler set.

scheduler.title: Canonical task Scheduler
scheduler.role: Claim queued tasks, arbitrate resources, launch Workers, consume events and invoke the matching Finalizer.
must_not: Finalize an old attempt as a new attempt
invariants: Execution ownership key is task_id plus attempt
Worker and provider limits are independent named resources
Provider work across distinct projects is not serialized by a global project-write claim
Worker artifacts are durably registered before result
Finalizer runs only after a successful current-attempt completion

recovery.strategy: Persist interruption; a new attempt may reuse handler-approved accepted artifacts.
recovery.terminal: Record exact finalizer exception as a structured error.

worker_supervisor.title: Worker process supervisor
worker_supervisor.role: Own exactly one Worker process tree per handle, enforce JSONL protocol, timeout, cancellation, drain and cleanup.
must_not: Publish completion before readers and residual processes are resolved
invariants: stdout is protocol-only
stderr is always drained
Residual process tree cleanup is confirmed before completion

recovery.strategy: Retain ownership and retry cleanup until bounded shutdown reports unresolved state.
recovery.terminal: Return failed, cancelled or timed_out completion.

worker_protocol.title: Worker JSONL protocol
worker_protocol.role: Strictly serialize and parse Worker command, control and message envelopes.
invariants: task_id and attempt match the active execution
Sequence is monotonic
Result follows artifact registration

recovery.strategy: Reject the message and fail the current attempt without guessing fields.

credential_store.title: Credential store and resolver
credential_store.role: Persist purpose/provider-named secrets in the portable data root and resolve them only into the owning Worker process environment.
must_not: Bind secrets to a backend instance, Windows user or machine
Use one credential name for multiple purposes
invariants: Credential authority is the complete portable data root plus purpose/provider
Ciphertext and its key migrate together
Public configuration reports presence only

recovery.strategy: Report the exact unavailable credential; already downloaded fingerprint-bound results remain locally finalizable.
restarts: provider request only when no accepted result exists

transcription_handler.title: Transcription task handler
transcription_handler.role: Validate immutable transcription input, resolve media/safe retry material and prepare the transcription Worker.
invariants: Media path is contained by the project
Retry source is fingerprint-bound
Cloud Qwen transcription claims worker, media CPU and provider I/O but not local GPU
Completed Qwen checkpoint can finalize without credentials

recovery.strategy: Reuse provider submission or completed result only when the transcription input fingerprint matches.

transcription_worker.title: Transcription Worker
transcription_worker.role: Prepare media, call the configured recognition pipeline, materialize evidence artifacts and emit registered results.
invariants: Evidence remains immutable
Artifacts are emitted before result
Input fingerprint binds all resumable state

recovery.strategy: Seed only fingerprint-matching prior attempt state and continue from the last durable provider checkpoint.

cloud_transcription_pipeline.title: Cloud transcription media pipeline
cloud_transcription_pipeline.role: Probe media, extract canonical audio, invoke Qwen ASR and materialize provider-independent evidence files.
must_not: Let FFmpeg inherit the Worker protocol stdin or run without a deadline
invariants: Audio identity is hashed
FFmpeg audio preparation uses -nostdin, DEVNULL stdin and a media-duration-bounded timeout
Provider output is converted once into the recognition evidence contract

recovery.strategy: Reuse canonical audio and provider state when their input fingerprint matches.

qwen_connector.title: Qwen Cloud ASR connector
qwen_connector.role: Upload audio, submit asynchronous Qwen transcription, poll, download and parse sentence/word/speaker evidence.
must_not: Leak API keys or signed URLs into public artifacts
invariants: Remote task id is persisted before polling
Downloaded result is fingerprint-bound
Raw punctuation and sentence hypotheses are preserved as evidence

recovery.strategy: Resume the same remote task or reuse its completed downloaded result; never resubmit merely because local finalization lacks a credential.

transcription_finalizer.title: Transcription Finalizer
transcription_finalizer.role: Revalidate registered evidence artifacts and atomically publish immutable transcription evidence into the project.
invariants: Every artifact hash and size matches its registered row
Evidence input/media fingerprint matches the task
No secret or absolute path enters the public result

recovery.strategy: Finalize a fingerprint-bound completed result locally without calling Qwen again.

segmentation_handler.title: Segmentation task handler
segmentation_handler.role: Validate immutable segmentation input, resolve evidence/prompts/reference and prepare a normal or artifact-recovery Worker.
must_not: Rerun accepted work after finalization-only failure
invariants: Evidence and prompt snapshots match the request
Provider execution claims worker and provider I/O without holding a global project-write resource
A retry may reuse only the immediately prior complete accepted artifact set

recovery.strategy: If prior accepted artifacts exist, launch recovery mode with no provider credential; otherwise run unresolved segmentation work.

segmentation_input_contract.title: Canonical segmentation input projection
segmentation_input_contract.role: Derive one unpunctuated, reindexed editor timeline from immutable recognition evidence, expanding CJK blocks by character and retaining alphabetic words.
invariants: Indexes are contiguous
CJK block timing is divided equally across characters
Alphabetic word units remain intact
Timing coverage and speaker identity are preserved
Worker and Finalizer call this same authority

recovery.strategy: Rebuild deterministically from the same immutable evidence.

segmentation_worker.title: Segmentation Worker
segmentation_worker.role: Build canonical material, run semantic grouping, deterministic reference-script alignment, or artifact recovery, validate candidates and emit every artifact before result.
must_not: Use ASR punctuation or sentence boundaries to create Cue breaks in reference-script mode
Replace unresolved model or reference content with semantic guesses
Call the segmentation model in reference-script mode
invariants: All candidate source tokens come from canonical ASR material
Reference-script corrections may replace or insert display text but never delete ASR-only content
Reference-script Cue boundaries come only from locally aligned reference punctuation
Configured source language and Unicode tokenizer version are deterministic Worker inputs
Failed alignment downgrades every automatic reference replacement to an advisory suggestion
Warning alignment applies only exact lexical-anchor presentation changes
Ambiguous phrase rewrites retain ASR and remain reversible editor suggestions
Accepted groups survive partial failure
Per-block response, completion, repair and failure counts cross the standard Worker progress protocol while algorithm diagnostics remain isolated from protocol stdout
Recovery emits all artifact events before result

recovery.strategy: Copy and re-register a complete accepted prior artifact set, then rerun Finalizer only; otherwise preserve accepted groups and repair unresolved gaps once.
recovery.terminal: Deliver unresolved ranges as problem subtitles.

execution_planner.title: Long-media execution planner
execution_planner.role: Choose deterministic approximately 90-second processing seams bounded to 75--100 seconds; bootstrap split uses observable timing evidence, while downstream stages replan only at accepted AI meaning-group boundaries.
must_not: Use ASR punctuation or sentence flags
invariants: Blocks cover every word once
Bootstrap seams are execution boundaries, not semantic Cue decisions
After accepted AI split, calibration, translation and review inherit one recalculated plan whose seams are accepted meaning-group boundaries
Out-of-range blocks are explicit exceptions rather than silently cutting through a meaning group

recovery.strategy: Recompute deterministically from the same word timeline.
recovery.terminal: Use the closest timing seam, never semantic content fallback.

semantic_segmentation_algorithm.title: Semantic grouping algorithm
semantic_segmentation_algorithm.role: Ask the configured Flash model in low-effort semantic mode for meaning groups and Cue cuts without forcing provider JSON mode, freeze valid ranges, repair rejected gaps once and register unresolved gaps; locally materialize the accepted semantics and recalculate the downstream work plan.
must_not: Reorder, delete or rewrite source tokens
Replace valid model output with deterministic semantic content
Roll back valid groups because another group failed
invariants: Every response is fingerprint-bound
Initial model requests run concurrently over the bootstrap work plan
The file-backed block ledger may notify its owning Worker after each durable update but never writes RuntimeStore directly
Valid ranges are frozen before repair
The program materializes model-authored semantics but never authors fallback semantic content
Each unresolved range remains visible as a problem subtitle

recovery.strategy: One repair request contains all rejected gaps while accepted groups remain frozen.
recovery.terminal: Register remaining gaps as problem subtitles.

segmentation_model_connector.title: Segmentation model connector
segmentation_model_connector.role: Render versioned prompts, apply stage-specific model scheduling and call the active cloud OpenAI-compatible provider endpoint.
must_not: Leak keys into logs or artifacts
invariants: Primary and repair stages use settings-selected models
Provider authentication mode and query-bearing deployment URL survive the immutable task snapshot
The production default is deepseek-v4-flash with low reasoning for segmentation and Flash non-thinking fallback for rejected units
Prompt snapshot hash is auditable
Provider JSON response mode is not forced; the local materializer validates the compact semantic response

recovery.strategy: Retry the unresolved model range according to configured attempts; never discard already accepted groups.

segmentation_finalizer.title: Segmentation Finalizer
segmentation_finalizer.role: Revalidate registered segmentation artifacts against the same canonical projection, commit Revision 1 and publish the project atomically.
must_not: Add punctuation or alter Cue content
Compare a different source projection than the Worker
invariants: Worker and Finalizer share the same normal or reference-script materializer, source language and tokenizer version
All artifact hashes match durable registrations
A readable revision exists before task success is projected as editor-ready

recovery.strategy: Use the prior complete accepted artifact set and rerun only registration plus Finalizer.
recovery.terminal: finalization_failed with exact exception type and bounded reason.

project_store.title: ProjectStore revision repository
project_store.role: Validate and atomically persist immutable editor revisions with optimistic concurrency and integrity checks.
invariants: Revision IDs are immutable
Document hashes verify reconstructed content
Expected revision enforces optimistic concurrency
Any later document revision clears completion unless the revision explicitly sets the completion attribute

recovery.strategy: Load the latest verified revision; reject corrupt or conflicting writes.

editor_api.title: Editor HTTP API
editor_api.role: Expose project/revision/media endpoints and revision-bound editing, reference-manuscript, translation, calibration and external-AI exchange commands.
must_not: Allow edits while an exclusive AI operation is running
Use historical v2 names in public routes
invariants: Every document mutation binds expected_revision_id
Task information changes never rewrite existing ASR, Cue topology, timing or translations
A project-selected LLM provider freezes its own endpoint, model and credential reference into each new calibration or translation task
Editor reference matching uses the canonical project source language or explicit Auto detection
Low-confidence editor reference matches remain advisory and do not mutate the revision
External prooftranslation applies only matching Cue and source hashes
External segmentation binds the exact revision, document and token sequence and cannot replace existing translations
Only one exclusive AI operation runs per project
AI results bind the revision they inspected

recovery.strategy: Reload the latest revision and durable AI operation state.
restarts: failed AI operation when user requests
recovery.terminal: Return structured conflict or task error.

task_info_service.title: Canonical project task information service
task_info_service.role: Load, validate and atomically save the required v2 project task-information fields, including the optional project-scoped LLM provider.
must_not: Synthesize metadata from a legacy project
invariants: task_info.json is required and is the only runtime authority
Missing project provider selection resolves to inherit without migrating the schema
All fields are committed atomically
Unsupported project versions are rejected

recovery.strategy: Reject invalid updates and retain the prior task_info.json.
recovery.terminal: Return an explicit validation error without document mutation.

translation_service.title: Editor translation service
translation_service.role: Run revision-bound translation through Task Runtime, preserve accepted groups, and materialize translated or blank editable targets for every Cue.
must_not: Discard valid groups because another group failed
invariants: Model sees meaning-unit context
Each unit has one primary request and at most one repair request
The whole task enters repair at most once
Accepted groups survive unrelated failures
Every unresolved Cue has empty editable manual-required target text
Final partial success is succeeded_with_issues

recovery.strategy: Register successful Cue results, repair all unresolved Cues once, and mark any remainder as problem subtitles.
recovery.terminal: Persist problem-subtitle markers without replacing content.

calibration_service.title: AI calibration service
calibration_service.role: Apply model-authored punctuation, casing, terminology, proper-name and ASR lexical corrections to the source track.
must_not: Apply an action the model marked review-only
Use advisory review as automatic correction
invariants: Calibration inherits the accepted-split execution plan and runs independent blocks concurrently
Each block sees ordered source Cues with its required context
A bounded per-run user instruction may refine terminology and attention but cannot expand the frozen calibration action contract or change Cue timing/topology
Every action binds exact Cue/token text
Model disposition is authoritative

recovery.strategy: Preserve valid block actions, repair all invalid blocks once, and expose unresolved items for review.
recovery.terminal: Leave unresolved source text unchanged and flagged.

media_service.title: Editor media and waveform service
media_service.role: Describe project audio/video kind, serve project media with Range support, provide bounded cached waveform windows, detect adaptive local speech onsets for smart Cue snapping, and materialize verified packaged tutorial media into the canonical project locations.
must_not: Load whole media into API memory
invariants: Media path is project-contained
Media kind prefers frozen stream evidence over filename inference
Waveform request is bounded
Smart forward snapping searches only the available preceding gap up to one second, requires a local silence-to-speech transition, preserves a bounded pre-roll, and never crosses the previous Cue
Launching an advanced packaged tutorial repairs both canonical audio locations from the hash-verified example asset
HTTP Range semantics remain valid

recovery.strategy: Rebuild waveform cache from canonical audio; media relink is explicit.

editor_ui.title: Editor browser application
editor_ui.role: Render bounded Cue windows and the scrollable project picker, route audio/video elements through one currentTime playback clock, synchronize Cue/subtitle/waveform state, expose project model selection and failed-task recovery, and submit revision-bound operations including reversible blank replacements.
must_not: Edit while exclusive AI operation is running
Rewrite canonical source tokens outside operations
invariants: Selected project_id never silently falls back to another project
The project picker lists every project in a bounded scroll region and marks completed projects with the secondary-color corner
Large Cue lists are windowed

Cue redraws use keyed incremental reconciliation: unchanged Cue DOM remains in place, changed/new rows alone are patched, duplicate nodes are removed by final node identity, and reconciliation never reads or writes the scrollbar
External review uses the same button-anchored ordinary command-popover component as task information and never owns draggable or viewport-position state

External review is a read-only text projection: current and selected scopes include exactly five surrounding active Cues on each side where available, full scope includes all active Cues, and no provider or editor mutation is invoked
External review preserves Cue timing, upper/lower subtitle text and translation meaning-unit evidence, and explicitly permits one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many translation mappings
Every user-visible export opens the operating-system Save As picker before requesting or writing bytes
Space inserts text only in a real text-editing context; without modifiers it toggles media playback everywhere else through one capture-phase shortcut route
The editor export menu exposes exactly upper subtitle, lower subtitle, upper/lower single-line subtitle, upper/lower double-line subtitle and portable subtitle project
AI calibration uses a button-anchored compact menu whose project-scoped optional instruction affects one run only
Running editor AI tasks render their durable backend progress in the same title/progress/message hierarchy as split-page pipeline cards
Informational copy/export notices use the ordinary theme and only actual failures use the red error treatment
Document edits use the current revision basis
The task-information dialog edits exactly name, source language, target language and both track line lengths
Task information changes do not rewrite existing subtitle content
Editor import accepts portable subtitle projects only
Audio and video use the same currentTime authority for Cue, subtitle and timeline following
Playback UI never depends on the existence of video frames
Virtual CJK lines have character boundaries without word gaps
Word-language lines retain virtual gaps
Right-clicking an auxiliary point or virtual boundary splits after its left token
Right-clicking the final purple connector merges the next Cue
Left-clicking remains reserved for token selection
Applied corrections, active insertions, deleted reference insertions, advisory suggestions and retained ASR have distinct reference markers
Reference choices appear above the selected token and remain reversible

Search supports contiguous token sequences; combined auto snap computes every smart forward start first, moves touching non-manual Cue pairs as one shared boundary, then evaluates bounded backward filling against the remaining gaps; and every editor control including speaker setup shares the operation lock contract

recovery.strategy: Reload the current project revision and operation state; retain no speculative backend truth.
recovery.terminal: Show the exact structured API error.

editor_api_client.title: Editor browser API caller
editor_api_client.role: Own editor HTTP request construction, error decoding, project identity and response-to-store handoff.
must_not: Treat HTTP success as revision success without validating payload
Retry mutating operations without their operation identity
invariants: Every project URL uses the selected stable project_id
Mutation responses advance the local revision basis atomically
Structured API errors remain visible

recovery.strategy: Abort or ignore stale requests and reload the selected project plus latest revision.

editor_domain.title: Editor document domain and operation engine
editor_domain.role: Define tokens, Cues, groups, timing/order invariants, mode-aware non-mutating validation and pure document operations.
must_not: Conflate user operations with AI operation state
invariants: Source-token lineage is immutable
Cue ordering and timing are valid
Active Cue intervals are half-open and a manual insert or boundary mutation cannot introduce overlap
Manual Cue insertion is not subject to the configured minimum duration
Reference-script source length is advisory while normal-mode hard limits remain hard
Operations are deterministic and revision-independent pure transformations

recovery.strategy: Reject the operation and retain the prior immutable revision.

editor_application.title: Editor application and repository ports
editor_application.role: Apply revision-bound operations through a repository abstraction and translate domain conflicts into API-safe conflicts.
invariants: Every write carries expected_revision_id
Repository conflicts are explicit
Operation batches commit atomically

recovery.strategy: Reload the latest revision and let the caller rebase explicitly.

reference_manuscript_service.title: Reference manuscript service
reference_manuscript_service.role: Parse TXT/DOCX/SRT with a Unicode script-aware tokenizer, apply aligned reference spelling, casing, punctuation and boundaries over ASR timing, preserve ASR-only wording with retained-source markers, and produce reversible corrections, insertions and audit records.
must_not: Delete content merely because the reference omits it
Silently change Cue topology in the editor
Use filename matching as content authority
invariants: Reference input, source language and break symbols are fingerprint-bound
Unicode letters, marks, numbers, Han, kana and Hangul are covered by one versioned tokenizer
Normalization affects matching identity but never silently rewrites display text
Recognition evidence remains the source, wording and timing authority
ASR-only text and punctuation remain visible but do not create Cue breaks
Reference punctuation remains attached to the resolved spoken sentence ending
Reference-only wording may be inserted on its correct boundary side
ASR-only wording remains active
Script mismatch or failed quality keeps replacements advisory
Ambiguous phrase rewrites are suggestions rather than automatic replacements
Editor changes are reversible operations

recovery.strategy: Retain the original evidence and expose unmatched ranges for human review.

presentation_service.title: Presentation, punctuation and script conversion
presentation_service.role: Project stored text into source/translation display lines and perform explicit generic, Taiwan-vocabulary or Hong-Kong-vocabulary Chinese script conversion.
must_not: Use display punctuation as segmentation authority
invariants: Presentation is reversible configuration
Taiwan and Hong Kong targets include regional vocabulary conversion
Stored semantic text remains separate from display punctuation

recovery.strategy: Reject invalid settings and retain the previous revision.

export_service.title: Subtitle export service
export_service.role: Render verified source, target and bilingual SRT outputs from the current revision and presentation rules.
invariants: Output is derived from one verified revision
Unavailable target tracks are reported rather than synthesized

recovery.strategy: Reload and render the latest verified revision.

project_exchange_service.title: Portable subtitle project exchange
project_exchange_service.role: Export or atomically import portable subtitle projects with media; historical external-AI exchange APIs remain backend-compatible but are not exposed by the editor.
must_not: Programmatically rewrite accepted translations across changed Cue topology
Accept external segmentation for a stale revision or unknown token boundary
Trust ZIP paths or declared hashes without verification
invariants: Exports use one committed latest revision
External prooftranslation carries one prompt that stops for source approval before translation
The prompt registry routes prooftranslation by source and target language and segmentation by source language
Translation planning supports 1:1, 1:N, N:1, N:M and target-language-local reordering while preserving Cue time slots
Combined returned source and translation units bind the same exported Cue/source hash so one atomic revision can apply both
Conflicts do not discard independent valid results
Source correction changes display text only
External segmentation returns only ordered after-token boundary IDs; Substar derives timing without changing source or display tokens
External segmentation rejects deleted Cues, repeated projections, manual tokens without ASR lineage, stale inputs, hard-limit violations and projects with accepted translations
Portable projects retain one canonical task_info.json instead of independent creation and editor preference states
Portable import validates paths, sizes, compression ratios and SHA-256 before atomic registration
Editor and split project lists derive from the same imported project directory
failure_modes: Revision, document, token-sequence or source-hash conflict

recovery.strategy: Retain the current revision and remove the temporary import directory; report conflicting units separately.
recovery.terminal: Return an explicit validation error without a half-project.

settings_ui.title: Settings browser application and API caller
settings_ui.role: Edit non-secret configuration and registered production prompt components, manage cloud LLM provider drafts independently from ASR, submit purpose-specific keys, probe providers, show recognition configuration state, and expose advanced Worker/cloud/media/GPU/download resource limits.
must_not: Assume a masked key is plaintext
Edit prompt routes or silently overwrite a concurrently changed prompt component
invariants: Credential fields are purpose/provider named
Saved-key presence, verified connectivity and newly entered key are distinct states
The provider catalog contains only cloud/API LLM services and excludes local model installers and translation-only engines
Each provider keeps an independent endpoint/model/auth/timeout draft and switching never clears a credential
Connection tests are read-only probes and never save or activate a provider
Stage models inherit connection model changes unless explicitly overridden
Reasoning-effort choices come from persisted live probe results and thinking stages default to the lowest verified effort
Recognition category state reflects the selected profile credential readiness
Advanced resource settings map one-to-one to Scheduler named limits and take effect after restart
Every stage/fallback control maps to a real runtime setting
Only registered prompt component bodies are editable and every save carries the loaded SHA-256
Prompt route selection and ordered composition are read-only
General settings expose distinct undo/redo shortcut recorders without a persistent export-directory control or dubbing-only controls
failure_modes: Endpoint not included in the active edition

recovery.strategy: Reload settings and runtime identity; never erase a saved key because a probe failed.

settings_service.title: Configuration and edition service
settings_service.role: Validate, persist and expose non-secret settings, edition capabilities, data roots and provider credential presence.
must_not: Select different storage by backend instance
invariants: One install/data-root policy is deterministic
Secrets and settings are persisted separately
The active provider is an explicit stable ID rather than a Base URL inference
Provider profiles persist independently while stage bindings consume only the active profile
Undo/redo shortcuts are canonicalized, collision-checked and persisted as ordinary non-secret settings
Obsolete persisted export-directory values are ignored
Worker and cloud resource defaults are four and every advanced limit is range-validated
Development and portable editions use the same semantic settings

recovery.strategy: Use the last valid settings snapshot and report the exact invalid field or storage error.

provider_test_service.title: Provider test, discovery and capability service
provider_test_service.role: Perform explicit connectivity probes, model discovery and reasoning-capability normalization for configured providers.
must_not: Reuse test prompts as production work
Report sandbox network failure as provider credential failure
invariants: Tests run with the requested provider ID/base URL/model and its own saved or draft key
Connectivity tests may retry without optional thinking or structured-output controls but capability probes remain strict
Tests never mutate provider profiles or active stage bindings
Errors are redacted
Reasoning capability claims distinguish verified from inferred

recovery.strategy: Retry only on explicit user request with full network authority; preserve saved credentials.

model_stage_scheduler.title: Prompt registry and per-stage model scheduler
model_stage_scheduler.role: Resolve versioned prompts, freeze primary/repair policy, and route every text-model JSON request through one provider-capability-aware gateway.
must_not: Use hard-coded models when a stage setting exists
Assign reasoning effort to non-thinking mode
Load prompts outside the frozen snapshot for creation tasks
Expose registry route mutation through settings
Accept a prompt save whose SHA-256 basis is stale
invariants: Every production primary and repair call resolves through a named stage
Provider, model, credential reference, thinking mode and reasoning effort are frozen in task input
Provider capability mapping happens once
Transport retries are bounded and distinct from the single semantic repair phase

recovery.strategy: Reject unresolved stage configuration before a provider call.

glossary_ui.title: Glossary browser application and API caller
glossary_ui.role: Edit, import and export terminology and show its activation scope.
must_not: Treat display name as immutable identity
invariants: Import is validated before replacing the stored glossary
Active status and scope are explicit

recovery.strategy: Keep the prior glossary when validation or persistence fails.

glossary_service.title: Glossary, hotword and XLSX service
glossary_service.role: Normalize terminology, select active project entries, compile ASR hotwords and LLM prompt context, and import/export XLSX.
must_not: Mutate a frozen task snapshot after creation
Conflate ASR hotword and translation instruction formats
invariants: Task snapshots are immutable
Provider-specific compilation derives from one normalized entry set
Secrets never enter glossary data

recovery.strategy: Reject the new glossary atomically and retain the previous valid set.

launcher_runtime.title: Launcher, backend instance ownership and graceful shutdown
launcher_runtime.role: Enforce one backend per install identity, start the backend, open the correct UI and stop the exact recorded process safely.
must_not: Kill a process without PID/start-time/install-root proof
Use socket disappearance as proof of process exit
Let launcher and backend own conflicting runtime records
Start the Windows backend without a user-visible taskbar console
Create a second backend for network or end-to-end testing
invariants: Force-stop requires PID creation time and install-root match
Launcher shutdown deadline exceeds backend global shutdown budget
Runtime records are install-root scoped
Every Windows backend inherits one visible launcher console and headless ASGI startup fails closed
The start script exits with the launcher and never pauses an obsolete console after its backend has stopped
Network and end-to-end verification reuse the visible formal backend rather than spawning a test backend
Runtime identity reports the launch surface
Runtime identity uses the release version plus the exact source commit and never treats a build-time placeholder as an install identity

recovery.strategy: Probe identity, wait for graceful shutdown, then use strictly verified process-tree termination only as fallback.

local_environment_service.title: Optional local environment and model assets
local_environment_service.role: Diagnose source-install local runtimes and manage optional local model paths/assets outside the cloud-only beta path.
must_not: Claim availability in an edition that does not expose its routes
Leak into the cloud-only release capability manifest
invariants: Capability exposure matches edition
Cloud workflow never depends on local model readiness

recovery.strategy: Keep the capability unavailable and report its exact prerequisite.

web_shell.title: Static web routes, theme and personalization
web_shell.role: Serve the four application pages and maintain shared visual personalization without owning business state.
invariants: Navigation targets stable canonical routes
Personalization remains presentation-only

recovery.strategy: Fall back to default visual settings without altering project data.

recognition_contracts.title: Recognition profile and artifact contracts
recognition_contracts.role: Register supported recognition profiles and validate provider-independent transcription artifacts.
invariants: Profiles have stable ids
Evidence schema is provider-independent
Artifact writes are atomic

recovery.strategy: Reject invalid artifacts and retain the last verified evidence.

segmentation_domain.title: Segmentation domain helpers and validators
segmentation_domain.role: Define chunks, hierarchy, candidate materialization, hard-limit validation and semantic grouping contracts used by the production algorithm.
invariants: One canonical source projection
Coverage and order are exact
Reference-script request defaults resolve break symbols from the frozen source language
Reference-only insertions enter the editor document as deleted display tokens with no source lineage
Hard-limit failures identify precise rejected ranges

recovery.strategy: Return exact rejected ranges to model repair without altering accepted ranges.

translation_domain.title: Translation domain contracts and grouping
translation_domain.role: Build meaning-unit groups, validate model output and persist translation artifacts used by the translation service.
must_not: Accept duplicate final ownership for a Cue
invariants: Meaning groups preserve source order
Every final Cue text has unique ownership
Program validation does not rewrite model wording

recovery.strategy: Preserve every valid group and independently retry only invalid groups with the configured repair stage/model for the configured number of attempts.
restarts: one invalid group per repair attempt
recovery.terminal: Keep unresolved Cues explicit; never synthesize fallback translation text.

shared_security_utilities.title: Shared filesystem, security and canonicalization utilities
shared_security_utilities.role: Provide contained paths, atomic writes, stable normalization and safe command construction for production modules.
invariants: Paths stay within declared roots
Writes are atomic
Canonical hashes are deterministic

recovery.strategy: Fail closed and retain the prior durable file.

packaging.title: Windows portable packaging and release contract
packaging.role: Copy the same visible application code, explicit Worker entrypoints, web/prompts/schemas and a fixed Python/FFmpeg runtime into the transparent portable directory.
invariants: Development and portable builds execute byte-identical source modules
Only explicit production Worker scripts are packaged
The editor model-request Worker used by built-in calibration is an explicit required portable file
The build writes the exact source commit into the bundled release manifest before archive creation
Release contains generated system-map documents
Fixed runtime and test dependency versions are verified
GitHub builds materialize the ignored Python and FFmpeg runtime before installing test-only dependencies
GitHub preview and release execute the same Python and Node contract suites as local validation
Release tests use a repository-scoped temporary root
Release smoke tests execute transparent contracts

recovery.strategy: Fail the build before archive creation; fix source or packaging manifest and rebuild from scratch.

subtitle_creation.title: Upload to editable project
subtitle_creation.success: A readable editor_revision exists and the creation projection is awaiting_edit; reference mode retains ASR-only text, applies auditable reference corrections or insertions, and cuts only at frozen literal symbols.

segmentation_finalization_recovery.title: Accepted Worker result to finalization-only retry
segmentation_finalization_recovery.success: Prior accepted artifacts are re-registered and committed without another provider call.

editor_translation.title: Revision-bound AI translation
editor_translation.success: One final model-authored target text is committed for each resolved Cue and unresolved Cues remain explicit.

editor_calibration.title: Revision-bound AI calibration
editor_calibration.success: Validated model-authored source corrections are committed without topology changes.

editor_review.title: External AI review text projection
editor_review.success: The current, selected or full subtitle range is copied or saved as a read-only review prompt with fixed five-Cue context, timing, both subtitle lines and semantic mapping evidence.

settings_and_provider_test.title: Settings, credentials and real provider probe
settings_and_provider_test.success: A purpose-specific credential and stage policy are saved once and the requested provider is tested with a redacted result.

glossary_to_models.title: Glossary to ASR and LLM snapshots
glossary_to_models.success: One normalized glossary snapshot is compiled into provider-appropriate hotwords and prompt context and remains auditable for the task.

editor_reference_and_export.title: Reference manuscript and subtitle export
editor_reference_and_export.success: Aligned reference replacements and reference-only insertions are active; ASR-only wording remains active with retained-source records; exports render the resulting active tokens from one verified revision.

external_ai_and_project_exchange.title: Portable subtitle project exchange
external_ai_and_project_exchange.success: The editor exposes only portable subtitle-project import/export; a verified archive becomes one new project visible from both editor and split without overwriting existing data.

portable_startup_and_shutdown.title: Portable package startup, runtime identity and shutdown
portable_startup_and_shutdown.success: One exact user-visible backend instance starts from the portable bundle, is reused for network/end-to-end verification, and exits only after bounded Worker cleanup or strictly verified fallback termination.
